title: Howdy

replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body:
Howdy,

Regarding the first link, you were indeed bullying. As you have stated when you were a Teamspeak Developer, The Heavy Bullying rule is a rule that staff members use when necessary. This is a rule you created and it is still in place. Inside Chat #7, you have made fun of his grandmother which he finds very disturbing and uncomfortable. Since he sees this as heavy bullying, I have given him the all clear to ban you. This was your fault and even though he isn't a staff member, he is still allowed to give out punishments when no staff members are online.

For the guy being moved to the Music room, he admits this was his fault and he was trying to move another player in the room who was playing music. 

For the sticky, he was testing to see what the player would do because we caught him ban evading. Funny enough. that account left and joined on a new identity proving that he was in fact your best bud, Steven.

For Albert, He is not your friend. This is in fact another player on the Avicus Network, who I will not disclose for privacy reasons. This player is WAY off the times they are usually online (timezone) and was obviously not the actual player as the location of the IP/VPN used was off by a lot.

Have a nice day!
